entries.name: UI_HoradricCube_UpdatePanel
entries.notes: Standalone Horadric Cube panel update with proven x64 ABI (panel) -> void. It resolves grid, flourish and convert, updates native widget state and tail-calls the base update path. TransmuteHotkey pins the strict 32-byte entry beginning at 0x2CDA90 despite the wider unwind range beginning at 0x2CDA80, calls the original first and dispatches only the embedded message of the same panel's visible enabled convert button.

entries.name: UI_FindTopLevelPanelByName
entries.notes: Finds a top-level panel by UTF-8 name with proven x64 ABI (const char* name) -> panel*. The 22-byte wrapper forwards the name and the global UI manager to 0x89F760 or returns null. TransmuteHotkey validates the wrapper and uses it only on the UI thread to refuse ChatPanel and known text-entry or confirmation modals.

entries.name: UI_IsHoradricCubePage
entries.notes: Recognizes native inventory page 3 as the Horadric Cube in the quick-move eligibility path. The corresponding D2R 2.4 helper is at 0x130DC0. EquippedItemToCube leaves this helper unchanged.

entries.name: UI_CanQuickMoveItemToCube
entries.notes: Central Cube quick-move eligibility helper. It validates the relevant panels, calls UI_IsHoradricCubePage, excludes the Cube item itself and keeps the native destination-space and transaction path. EquippedItemToCube does not patch this function.

entries.name: UI_HandleEquippedItemQuickMove
entries.notes: Hovered/equipped-item quick-move handler. It resolves the hovered unit, evaluates a new 3.2 client guard at 0x228B91, tests Ctrl at 0x228B9E and then reuses the native Cube eligibility and item-move path. The corresponding 2.4 handler lacks the new conditional exit.

entries.name: EquippedItemCubeEligibilityGuardBranch
entries.notes: Exact six-byte 0F 84 55 01 00 00 conditional exit introduced before the native Ctrl test in build 92777. EquippedItemToCube owns only 0x228B98..0x228B9D and replaces this branch with six NOPs after validating the 47-byte context at 0x228B81.

entries.name: OBJECTS_OperateFunction06_TowerTome
entries.notes: Build-92777 Tower Tome server handler with ABI (operation, operateMode) -> int32; the second argument is unused. The operation structure is observed at +0x00 game, +0x08 object, +0x10 player and +0x20 object class id. It rejects animation modes above 2, resolves quest 5, requires the quest intro gate, starts the operating animation and ENDANIM event, sends scroll string id 127 through QUESTS_SendScrollMessage, then advances the A1Q5 quest state. Its extended entry signature through both the animation-mode and quest-data calls is unique. D2MOO 1.10f is semantic evidence only; the 92777 control flow and data accesses independently prove the identity.

entries.name: QUESTS_SendScrollMessage
entries.notes: Authoritative server helper with ABI (game, player, unit, uint16 stringId) -> void. It resolves the player's client, builds the 0x28-byte server packet 0x27 as {header 0x27, unitType 2, unitGuid, one-message list, stringId}, and queues it through 0x47E340. Direct callers are 0x547DA6, 0x59EF50 and Tower Tome at 0x5DC61E. Its strict 30-byte prologue is unique in build 92777.

entries.name: QUESTS_GetQuestData
entries.notes: Resolves a server quest record with ABI (game, questId) -> questData*. It walks the quest chain rooted at game+0x21D8 and compares the requested id. Tower Tome calls it with quest id 5. Its strict 41-byte signature is unique in build 92777.

entries.name: DATATBLS_GetObjectsTxtRecord
entries.notes: Returns the compiled ObjectsTxt record with ABI (dataContext, objectClassId) -> ObjectsTxt*. It resolves the context data tables through 0x300A90, bounds the id against dataTables+0x1530, uses the record base at +0x1528 and a record size of 0x168. Tower Tome reads frame count at record+0x9C. Its strict 36-byte signature is unique in build 92777.

entries.name: CLIENT_HandleScrollMessagePacket27
entries.notes: Client handler for the server 0x27 message-list packet with ABI (packet) -> void. For unit type 2 and ordinary menu 0 it stores the object GUID from +0x02, reads the 16-bit string id from +0x0A and calls CLIENT_ShowScrollMessageById at 0x197BF0. The alternate menu-3 branch performs the direct LANG_GetStringById lookup. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in build 92777.

entries.name: CLIENT_ShowScrollMessageById
entries.notes: Creates the native scrolling-lore UI with ABI (uint16 stringId) -> void. It resolves the active-language UTF-8 text through LANG_GetStringById 0x5F4A50, builds the scroll widgets and marks the known lore ids including Tower Tome id 127. Its sole direct caller is CLIENT_HandleScrollMessagePacket27 at 0x19A801. A strict 64-byte signature including cookie setup, local context and initialization calls is unique in build 92777.

entries.name: ScrollMessageLocalizationCall
entries.notes: The sole LANG_GetStringById call inside CLIENT_ShowScrollMessageById. Exact bytes E8 EC CD 45 00 target 0x5F4A50 in build 92777. BookOfLore 0.2.0 validates the enclosing scroll function, the language resolver entry and this call before redirecting only this site through a near relay; it deliberately leaves the global localization prologue unhooked for PluginPack coexistence.

entries.name: CLIENT_TransferItemToInventoryPage
entries.notes: Computes a native free position and emits the 21-byte client inventory-transfer packet 0x54 with proven x64 ABI (item, owner, destinationPage, option, source, placementOut) -> bool. The strict 32-byte entry is pinned by EquippedItemToCube 0.2.0. RemoteStash 0.2.26 leaves this prologue untouched and redirects its eight direct D2R.exe callers through a near relay. For destination page 3, CubeQuickMove may redirect its INVENTORY_FindFreePosition call at 0x15F94F, and the returned x/y pair is copied both to placementOut and packet offsets +17/+19.

entries.name: UI_ButtonWidgetDispatchMessageCall
entries.notes: Exact E8 22 2D F5 FF call to UI_DispatchMessage immediately after lea rcx,[rdi+0x558] in UI_ButtonWidget_OnClick. RemoteStash 0.2.26 redirects only this call so plugin-skills remains free to own the dispatcher entry.

entries.name: RemoteStashClientTownLifecycleCall

entries.name: D2GAME_ITEMS_IdentifyStoredItem
entries.notes: Observed ABI (game, item, player) -> void. The function sets IFLAG_IDENTIFIED and performs the stored-item stat-list path when applicable, but does not itself send the complete item update or attach the vanilla identify sound. Its only direct caller at 0x4FD79D uses it during item creation before later placement and notification steps. entries.name: D2GAME_PACKETCALLBACK_Rcv0x2E
entries.notes: Authoritative server callback in dispatch-table slot 0x2E with ABI (game, player, packet, packetSize) -> int32 and an exact 0x15-byte size gate. The dispatch-table base is proven as 0x1D2A790 by RemoteStash's functional opcode 0x18 mapping to 0x4BFF30; 0x4AE280 is stored at 0x1D2A900, therefore index 0x2E.

entries.name: UI_RenderItemIcon

It has four direct callers, including the inventory loop call at 0x2A776C, and its 19-byte prologue is unique in build 92777. D2RLoader's inline trampoline prevents reliable _ReturnAddress filtering, so CharmZone leaves the native renderer unchanged and accepts only item pointers previously classified as inactive by its native charm-eligibility hook.

entries.name: D2GAME_NPC_TryDeductGold
entries.notes: Authoritative server helper with observed ABI (game, player, amount) -> int32. It returns zero without mutation when carried gold plus personal bank gold is insufficient; otherwise it debits carried gold first, then only the required remainder from the personal bank, and returns one. It reads stat ids 14 and 15, never the shared stash. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in build 92777 and D2GAME_NPC_RepairHandler calls it at 0x53FF7B.

entries.name: CLIENT_BuildNpcInteractionMenu
entries.notes: Builds the active NPC interaction menu from the native 72-byte-per-NPC action registry. For the Reset Stat/Skill Points entry identified by localized string id 11168, the branch at 0x114C14 reads current-difficulty quest 0x29 RewardGranted and RewardPending flags: a consumed reward is omitted, while a pending reward is added with the registered callback. entries.name: CLIENT_NpcMenuAction_ResetStatsAndSkills
entries.notes: Affirmative callback for the native Reset Stat/Skill Points confirmation. It closes the modal, reads the current NPC GUID, and calls CLIENT_SendFiveByteNpcCommandPacket at 0x11311A with opcode 0x39 and that GUID. The action is registered for Akara by the 0x109200 initializer under localized string id 11168.

entries.name: D2GAME_PACKETCALLBACK_Rcv0x39_ResetStatsAndSkillsWithNpc
entries.notes: Authoritative server callback with observed ABI (game, player, packet, packetSize) -> int32. A controlled 92777 runtime read proved slot 0x39 of the server callback table at D2R+0x1D2A790 points here. It requires exactly five bytes, decodes the NPC GUID at +1, validates the interaction and NPC service record, and for Akara requires current-difficulty quest 0x29 RewardPending before calling D2GAME_PLAYER_ResetStatsAndSkills at 0x4B2A23. Native first-use bookkeeping follows through QUESTS_ConsumeAkaraRespecReward.

entries.name: D2GAME_PLAYER_ResetStatsAndSkills
entries.notes: Native combined respec transaction with observed ABI (game, player) -> int32. Its only direct caller is the authoritative opcode 0x39 callback at 0x4B2A23. It resets and refunds invested skills through D2GAME_PLAYER_ResetSkills, resets base Strength/Energy/Dexterity/Vitality through D2GAME_PLAYER_ResetBaseStats, refreshes inventory and derived state, attaches the native sound, and returns one.

entries.name: D2GAME_PLAYER_ResetSkills
entries.notes: Iterates the player's class skill list, reads each invested base level, removes the skill ranks through the native reset/update path, sums the refunded ranks, and adds that total to stat id 5 (unspent skill points). D2GAME_PLAYER_ResetStatsAndSkills calls it first at 0x580F30.

entries.name: D2GAME_PLAYER_ResetBaseStats
entries.notes: Resets player base stat ids 0 through 3 to the class starting Strength, Energy, Dexterity and Vitality values, refunds the removed points into stat id 4, and routes the dependent life, mana and stamina recalculations through native helpers. D2GAME_PLAYER_ResetStatsAndSkills calls it at 0x580F3B.

entries.name: QUESTS_ConsumeAkaraRespecReward

It sets RewardGranted, clears RewardPending and then evaluates an additional quest flag before the remaining quest-event path. The opcode 0x39 callback is its only direct caller and invokes it only when the NPC service record carries a nonzero quest field. Paid repeats must bypass this routine to preserve quest flags bit-exactly.

entries.name: UNITS_GetUnitType

entries.name: D2GAME_MONSTERMODE_SetVelocityParams
entries.notes: Observed ABI (aiParam, pathType, velocityPercent, distance) -> void. It writes nonzero path type at aiParam+0x20, nonzero velocity percent at +0x24 and a clamped nonzero distance byte at +0x28. A zero velocity argument is a sentinel that normally preserves the previous field; RogueScoutMovement clears +0x24 explicitly only inside a thread-local, aiParam-matched Act I Rogue follow scope so an absolute configured velocity of 11 remains the exact BKVince baseline.

entries.name: D2GAME_PETAI_PetMove

D2MOO provides semantic ancestry: Hireable uses motion 0 for near following and motion 1 for catch-up, while later motion values cover wander, warp and spacing. entries.name: HDItemsJsonCodePaddingBlock

The Four Character Item Codes memory patch replaces the block in place with two symmetric byte reads and NUL-to-space fallbacks. entries.name: D2GAME_PACKETCALLBACK_Rcv0x34_IdentifyItemsWithNpc

entries.name: SUNITDMG_ExecuteEvents
entries.notes: Confirmed-static authoritative damage/event commit with logical bounds 0x44CE80..0x44D569 and ABI (game, attacker, defender, bMissile, D2Damage*) -> void. Its 31-byte entry signature is unique and it has 36 direct callers. Melee callsite 0x44B3FA passes bMissile=0 while missile callsite 0x436F95 passes 1, so this is a shared commit surface rather than an exclusively-melee hit seam.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc14_ItemFreeze
entries.notes: Confirmed-static EventFunc14 ItemFreeze callback. Its strict 32-byte entry signature is unique in build 92777; zero direct xrefs are expected because the native dispatcher calls handlers indirectly. The D2R callback frame transports nine positions, not a seven-argument ABI copied from legacy D2MOO.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc20_SkillOnAttackHitKill
entries.notes: Confirmed-static EventFunc20 callback for skill-on-attack/hit/kill nodes. Its strict 33-byte entry signature is unique; packed node payload uses high-word stat id and low-word layer before the layered stat getter. Dispatch is indirect with a nine-position D2R frame, so zero direct xrefs do not imply an unused handler.

entries.name: SUNIT_CanDamageTarget
entries.notes: Confirmed-static server target-permission predicate with logical bounds 0x48E060..0x48E248 and ABI (game, attacker, candidate) -> int32. Its 19-byte entry signature is unique; direct callers 0x44CEC1 and 0x44A9C9 prove its role before damage commit and finalization. It resolves owners/minions, town, rooms and hostile relation but does not prove distance or LOS.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues
entries.notes: Confirmed-static native damage builder with bounds 0x44C030..0x44CDC8 and ABI (game, attacker, defender, D2Damage*, mode, SrcDam) -> void. Its unique 30-byte signature and eight callers are governed. The mode-zero path resolves weapon-mastery Critical, passive Critical Strike, then Deadly Strike with short-circuiting; success doubles physical and sets the shared result bit 0x2000.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_ApplyDamageBonuses
entries.notes: Confirmed-static eight-argument native damage-bonus helper with bounds 0x44D710..0x44D9E5 and ABI (attacker, getStats, item, minDamage, maxDamage, enhancedPct, flatDamage, SrcDam) -> int32. Its 31-byte signature is unique with six callers and nine material callees. This proof establishes the generic helper only; it does not validate the prototype's historical Smite composition.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_ApplyMonsterCritical
entries.notes: Confirmed-static monster-critical stage with bounds 0x5889E0..0x588AF4, unique 32-byte signature and ABI (attacker, defender, D2Damage*) -> void. It rolls the attacker seed against MonStats chance and doubles six damage components. It does not set the player Critical/Deadly result bit 0x2000 and is therefore a distinct result path.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_CalculateTotalDamage
entries.notes: Confirmed-static component-aware damage resolver with bounds 0x44DF10..0x44ECE0 and ABI (game, attacker, defender, D2Damage*) -> void. Its 49-byte signature is unique with four callers. It applies resistances, reductions, absorb and final totals and delegates to the governed resistance resolver 0x4523E0.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_FinalizeDamage
entries.notes: Confirmed-static final damage/status/mode/death stage with bounds 0x44A9B0..0x44B2A2, unique 30-byte signature and ABI (game, attacker, defender, D2Damage*) -> void. It has 32 direct callers and follows ExecuteEvents on the governed melee and missile chains. Runtime ordering of reactions, death and packets remains a MEC-01 witness.

entries.name: D2Damage_CopyConstructor
entries.notes: Confirmed-static deep-copy constructor with bounds 0x4494B0..0x4496DF, unique 32-byte signature and ABI (destination, source) -> destination for the build-92777 0x180-byte D2Damage object. It copies scalars, reconstructs the internal SBO container and constructs the owned subobject at +0x158.

entries.name: D2Damage_Destructor
entries.notes: Confirmed-static destructor with bounds 0x4496E0..0x449752, unique 32-byte signature and ABI (D2Damage*) -> void for the 0x180-byte record. It destroys the owned subobject at +0x158 and releases the +0x40 container only when it is outside the inline SBO storage.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc15_OpenWounds

The native nine-position callback frame supplies game, event, attacker, target and packed layered-stat payload. It rolls the attacker seed, computes the native OW value and delegates state 62 to the generic curse/statlist helper; the exact BSS tuple for duration/stat id still requires a runtime read-only witness.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc16_CrushingBlow
entries.notes: Confirmed-static Crushing Blow event callback with bounds 0x583150..0x583276 and unique 32-byte signature. It consumes the D2Damage pointer and packed chance from the native nine-position callback frame, rolls the attacker seed, builds the target-class divisor context and calls the native Crushing Blow core at 0x581BD0.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_ApplyLifeAndManaLeech
entries.notes: Confirmed-static unique life/mana leech consumer with bounds 0x450C90..0x451380, unique 32-byte signature and ABI (game, attacker, defender, D2Damage*) -> void. Its only direct caller is ExecuteEvents at 0x44D038. It consumes raw percentages at D2Damage+0x120/+0x124, applies Drain and difficulty divisors, and rewrites those fields with native-adjusted percentages. It then derives and caps the separately credited life/mana amounts; the rewritten fields are not direct witnesses of the credited amounts.

entries.name: D2GAME_DispatchUnitStatEventList
entries.notes: Confirmed-static native unit-stat event-list dispatcher with bounds 0x5881E0..0x58844B and unique 16-byte signature. Eight direct callers include the damage-event wrapper at 0x44D5F2. It walks attacker+0xE0, invokes node callbacks through a nine-position D2R frame and safely performs deferred deletion after callback return.

entries.name: D2GAME_ApplyCrushingBlowCore
entries.notes: Confirmed-static Crushing Blow core with bounds 0x581BD0..0x581EC7, unique 24-byte signature and ABI (game, attacker, target, context) -> int32. Its two callers are 0x51D950 and EventFunc16 at 0x583257. It selects target divisors, applies player-count and physical resistance, writes HP, sets D2Damage result bit 2 on lethal damage and applies overlay 147 when positive.

entries.name: D2GAME_ApplyCurseStateStatList
entries.notes: Confirmed-static generic curse/state statlist applicator with bounds 0x433D20..0x4341DC, unique 24-byte signature and 32 callers including Open Wounds. It validates state/target, refreshes matching lists, rejects weaker replacements, unlinks mismatches, allocates and posts new lists, schedules expiration event 12 and installs a remove callback. It is generic and must not be named as an Open-Wounds-only primitive.

entries.name: D2GAME_DefaultCurseStateRemoveCallback
entries.notes: Confirmed-static default curse/state removal callback with bounds 0x436240..0x4362DC and unique 24-byte signature. It unregisters the pending event, preserves dead/stay-death handling, disables the state and refreshes animation, passives and player state as required. It is shared by generic state lists and is not Open-Wounds-exclusive.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_PrepareAndQueueCombatRecord
entries.notes: Confirmed-static combat-record preparation wrapper with logical bounds 0x44B600..0x44B71B, a unique 33-byte signature, 31 direct callers and ABI (game, attacker, defender, D2Damage*, SrcDam:uint8) -> void. It conditionally runs FillDamageValues, runs CalculateTotalDamage, derives WILLDIE and calls the unique combat-node linker at 0x44B703. It prepares target-specific state and is not a safe secondary-damage primitive.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_AllocateAndLinkCombatRecord
entries.notes: Confirmed-static combat-node allocator/linker with logical bounds 0x4507B0..0x4509A3, unique 32-byte signature and ABI (game, attacker, defender, const D2Damage*) -> void. Its only direct caller is 0x44B703. It allocates 0x1A0 bytes, records attacker/defender type and GUID, deep-copies D2Damage to node+0x18 and links the node under attacker+0x108; it applies no HP or reactions.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_ConsumeMeleeCombatRecord
entries.notes: Confirmed-static stored-melee-combat consumer with logical bounds 0x44B2B0..0x44B5F5, unique 34-byte signature, 36 direct callers and ABI (game, attacker, defender, rangeBonus) -> bool/uint8. It finds the node by type/GUID, deep-copies its D2Damage, validates range, calls ExecuteEvents with bMissile=0, performs additional melee events/durability/thorns work, calls FinalizeDamage and unlinks/frees the node. Its breadth makes it unsafe as a blind splash-target primitive.

entries.name: D2GAME_EnumerateUnitsInArea
entries.notes: Confirmed-static area-enumeration core with logical bounds 0x4398B0..0x439C04, unique 18-byte signature and eight direct callers. Its ten-position ABI carries game, origin, room/x/y descriptor, radius, mask, callback, user context, a special monster filter and source provenance. It walks the supplied room array and each room unit list in native order, applies square and inclusive radius gates and invokes callback(ctx,candidate). MEC-W07 remains partial because the upstream room-list membership and uniqueness/dedup invariants are not yet proven.

entries.name: DUNGEON_GetRoomListAndCount
entries.notes: Confirmed-static room-list accessor with bounds 0x2EFDE0..0x2EFDED, unique 13-byte body and ABI (room, roomListOut, roomCountOut) -> void. It returns room+0 and the count at room+0x40. Its use by the area enumerator is proven, but the exact adjacent-room membership is not promoted until the native writer/builder is identified.

entries.name: DUNGEON_GetFirstUnitInRoom
entries.notes: Confirmed-static one-argument room-unit-list accessor with bounds 0x2EFD90..0x2EFD98 and unique 8-byte body. It returns the pointer at room+0xA8 and is used by the governed area-enumeration traversal.

entries.name: UNITS_GetNextUnitInRoom
entries.notes: Confirmed-static room-list next-unit accessor with logical bounds 0x34B4A0..0x34B4DB and a unique strict 46-byte signature. It returns unit+0x160; the area enumerator reads this next pointer before filters and callback invocation.

entries.name: DUNGEON_DoesRoomIntersectSearchSquare
entries.notes: Confirmed-static inclusive broad-phase test with bounds 0x3256E0..0x325760 and unique 30-byte signature. ABI (room, centerX, centerY, radius) -> bool compares the search square against the room rectangle before per-unit traversal.

entries.name: COORDS_GetSquaredDistance
entries.notes: Confirmed-static squared-distance helper with bounds 0x3412C0..0x3412D3 and unique 19-byte body. ABI (x1, y1, x2, y2) -> int32 computes (x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2; the area enumerator accepts candidates when this value is less than or equal to radius squared.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc7_Knockback
entries.notes: Confirmed-static EventFunc7 Knockback handler with logical bounds 0x583E00..0x583F0F, a unique 30-byte entry signature and the governed nine-position event callback ABI. It has zero direct xrefs because the 92777 event-list dispatcher invokes callbacks indirectly. MeleeSplash filters this handler only while its thread-local synthetic-secondary guard is active.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc9_Blind
entries.notes: Confirmed-static EventFunc9 Blind handler with logical bounds 0x583400..0x58357B, a unique 30-byte entry signature and the governed nine-position event callback ABI. It has zero direct xrefs because dispatch is indirect. MeleeSplash filters it only for synthetic secondary resolution.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc19_Slow
entries.notes: Confirmed-static EventFunc19 Slow handler with logical bounds 0x5849D0..0x584B56, a unique 33-byte entry signature and the governed nine-position event callback ABI. It has zero direct xrefs because dispatch is indirect. MeleeSplash filters it only for synthetic secondary resolution.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc21_SkillOnGetHit
entries.notes: Confirmed-static EventFunc21 SkillOnGetHit handler with logical bounds 0x5837F0..0x583995, a unique 31-byte entry signature and the governed nine-position event callback ABI. It has zero direct xrefs because dispatch is indirect. MeleeSplash filters it only for synthetic secondary resolution.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_PreCriticalApplyDamageBonusesCall
entries.notes: Confirmed-static call inside SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues to 0x44D710 ApplyDamageBonuses. The five bytes E8 5F 14 00 00 and unique 21-byte context are governed. Its continuation at 0x44C2B1 stores EAX to D2Damage+0x18 immediately before the native mode-gated Critical/Deadly sequence.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_PreEvent3ApplyDamageEventCall
entries.notes: Confirmed-static conditional Event 3 call inside SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues. The five bytes E8 CD 09 00 00 and unique 34-byte context from 0x44CB89 are governed. ABI is int32(game, event, defender, attacker, D2Damage*), with continuation 0x44CBA3.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_DirectMeleeFillDamageValuesCall
entries.notes: Confirmed-static direct melee call to SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues with continuation 0x4300BB. Its unique 29-byte context begins at 0x43009E. The same stack D2Damage at caller rsp+0x70 then passes through 0x56CBE0 and into SUNITDMG_PrepareAndQueueCombatRecord at 0x4300DE with hit flag 0x02, so the wrapper skips a second Fill and continues through canonical Calculate, Allocate and Consume. A 2026-08-09 runtime witness with normal Attack confirmed capture at return 0x4300BB and a three-target synthetic burst.

entries.name: SEED_RollPowerOfTwo
entries.notes: Exact 35-byte leaf routine advancing the supplied native seed and returning nextLow & (upperBound - 1). The Rare generator calls it at 0x58BC98 with upperBound 8. ProgressiveAffixesPlugin validates it and uses it only for semantic vanilla fallback.

entries.name: D2GAME_ITEMS_GenerateCraftedAffixes
entries.notes: Build-92777 Crafted affix generator with observed ABI (item, generation) -> int32. The governed block reads item level at generation+0x18, computes minima at ilvl 1/31/51/71, rolls 0..4 through 0x153B00, then applies the selected count through native prefix/suffix selection and finalization.

entries.name: CraftedAffixCountRollCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 E0 98 BC FF to SEED_RollLimitedRandomNumber inside the Crafted generator. ProgressiveAffixesPlugin redirects it through a near relay receiving the existing seed in RCX, item in R15 and generation in R12.

entries.name: CraftedAffixVanillaMinimumClamp
entries.notes: Five-byte CMP/CMOVA sequence 3B D8 0F 47 C3 that clamps the Crafted RNG result to the vanilla ilvl minimum. ProgressiveAffixesPlugin NOPs it only after its relay has selected the complete configured 1..4 count.

entries.name: D2GAME_ITEMS_GenerateRareAffixes
entries.notes: Build-92777 Rare affix generator with observed ABI (item, generation) -> int32. It resolves existing affix state, obtains the native item seed, selects a 3..4 jewel count or regular eight-entry count, then uses native prefix/suffix selection with three-per-side limits and finalization.

entries.name: RareJewelAffixCountBranch
entries.notes: Two-byte JNE +0x29 separating the native jewel 3..4 LCG path from the regular Rare table path. ProgressiveAffixesPlugin changes it to JMP so jewels and regular items reach one configured selector while still consuming exactly one seed step.

entries.name: RareAffixCountSelectionBlock
entries.notes: Exact 30-byte block 0x58BC90..0x58BCAD loading bound 8, rolling the item seed and mapping the index through the native count table. ProgressiveAffixesPlugin replaces the full block with a rel32 call, moves EAX to R12D, restores R9=seed and rejoins the untouched loop at 0x58BCAE.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_WeaponMasteryCriticalChanceCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 18 12 EF FF inside SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues to the weapon-mastery Critical chance helper. The governed context supplies attacker, active weapon, argument3=0 and argument4=2; BKVCombat preserves that callee ABI and caps only the returned chance when its Critical policy is operational.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_PassiveCriticalChanceCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 F0 8C EA FF inside SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues to STATLIST_GetUnitStat for passive_critical_strike stat 337, layer 0. It is reached only after the weapon-mastery Critical branch fails and retains the native (unit, statId, layer) -> int32 ABI.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_DeadlyStrikeChanceCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 DC 98 EA FF inside SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues to STATLIST_UnitGetStatValue for item_deadlystrike stat 141, layer 0. It is reached only after both Critical branches fail and retains the native layered-stat ABI.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_DeadlyStrikeSuccessTail
entries.notes: Exact 17-byte native success tail 8B 47 18 03 C0 89 47 18 B8 00 20 00 00 66 09 47 04. The unique branch context at 0x44C3C2 distinguishes the Deadly-success path from Critical success; BKVCombat redirects this block and rejoins at 0x44C3D9 so only Deadly uses the configured 1.5x multiplier.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc16_CrushingBlowCoreCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 74 E9 FF FF from EventFunc16 to D2GAME_ApplyCrushingBlowCore at 0x581BD0. The preserved x64 ABI is int32(game, attacker, target, context); the int32 return is authoritative and EventFunc16 itself remains owned by MeleeSplash in the supported stack.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc15_OpenWoundsStatListCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 28 FA EA FF from EventFunc15 to D2GAME_ApplyCurseStateStatList at 0x433D20. ABI is StatList* (ApplyArgs*), where the 0x30-byte argument record carries source, target, skill, duration, stat, state and optional removal callback; EventFunc15 itself remains owned by MeleeSplash.

entries.name: D2GAME_EventFunc05_LifeTap
entries.notes: Confirmed-static Life Tap handler with logical bounds 0x55BCD0..0x55BFAC and a validated 32-byte entry signature. It uses the native event-callback frame and derives a separate life credit from resolved physical damage; it is not ordinary stat-60 life steal and BKVCombat validates but never hooks it.

entries.name: D2GAME_GetMinionOwner
entries.notes: Confirmed-static monster-minion owner resolver with logical bounds 0x4A53C0..0x4A547C, validated 32-byte entry signature and ABI Unit* (Unit* monster). It validates unit type, reads the monster owner identity and re-resolves that owner through SUNIT_GetServerUnit; null is returned when no live owner is available.

entries.name: UNITS_GetGame
entries.notes: Confirmed-static unit-to-game accessor with logical bounds 0x48FF00..0x48FF3A, validated 32-byte entry signature and ABI Game* (Unit*). For a valid unit it returns the pointer at unit+0xD8; BKVCombat uses it transiently while creating server-owned Open Wounds stat lists.

entries.name: STATLIST_GetStatListFromUnitAndState
entries.notes: Confirmed-static state-list lookup with validated entry signature and ABI StatList* (Unit*, int32 state). The Open Wounds lifecycle uses it to detect state 62 before disabling that state in the custom removal callback.

entries.name: STATLIST_AllocStatList
entries.notes: Confirmed-static stat-list allocator with validated 32-byte entry signature and ABI StatList* (uint32 flags, int32 expireFrame, int32 sourceType, uint32 sourceGuid). BKVCombat uses only the governed Open Wounds flags and immediately frees any partially initialized list on validation failure.

entries.name: STATLIST_SetStatListState
entries.notes: Exact nine-byte leaf setter 48 85 C9 74 03 89 51 20 C3 with ABI void (StatList*, int32 state). It stores the state at StatList+0x20 and is null-safe.

entries.name: STATLIST_SetStatListSkillId
entries.notes: Confirmed-static stat-list skill-ID setter with bounds 0x2F79B0..0x2F79F2, validated 32-byte signature and ABI void (StatList*, int32 skillId). It stores the value at StatList+0x28.

entries.name: STATLIST_SetStatListSkillLevel
entries.notes: Confirmed-static stat-list skill-level setter with bounds 0x2F7A00..0x2F7A42, validated 32-byte signature and ABI void (StatList*, int32 skillLevel). It stores the value at StatList+0x2C.

entries.name: STATLIST_SetStatListStat
entries.notes: Confirmed-static stat-list stat setter with bounds 0x2F7C00..0x2F7C14, validated 21-byte signature and ABI void (uint8 dataContext, StatList*, int32 statId, int32 value, uint16 layer). It tail-calls the native stat insertion primitive and is used for the negative stat-74 Open Wounds rate.

entries.name: STATLIST_SetStatListRemoveCallback
entries.notes: Exact 13-byte leaf setter 48 85 C9 74 07 48 89 91 80 00 00 00 C3 with ABI void (StatList*, RemoveCallback). It stores the callback at StatList+0x80 and is null-safe.

entries.name: STATLIST_SetStatListExpireFrame
entries.notes: Exact expire-frame setter with bounds 0x2F7AB0..0x2F7AC9 and validated 26-byte signature. ABI is void (StatList*, int32 frame); a positive frame sets list flag 0x2 and stores the frame as float at StatList+0x24.

entries.name: STATLIST_PostStatList
entries.notes: Confirmed-static stat-list posting primitive with validated 32-byte entry signature and ABI void (Unit* target, StatList*, int32 update). It links the list under the target's extended stat-list owner and updates the unit aggregate.

entries.name: STATLIST_UnlinkStatList
entries.notes: Confirmed-static unlink wrapper with bounds 0x2F7920..0x2F7939, validated 26-byte signature and ABI void (Unit* target, StatList*). It derives the target data context before tail-calling the internal unlink primitive.

entries.name: STATLIST_FreeStatList
entries.notes: Exact 16-byte stat-list free wrapper with bounds 0x2F4180..0x2F418F and ABI void (uint8 dataContext, StatList*). BKVCombat calls it only for a newly allocated unposted list or after explicit unlink, providing fail-closed rollback after allocation or post-validation failure.

entries.name: SUNITDMG_ApplyLifeAndManaLeechCall
entries.notes: Exact five-byte call E8 53 3C 00 00 from SUNITDMG_ExecuteEvents to the unique leech consumer at 0x450C90. The governed context starts at 0x44D02C and preserves ABI void (game, attacker, defender, D2Damage*); BKVCombat validates this baseline but installs no leech hook.
